draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Thane! Its biggest claim to fame is that India's first railway line ran from Bori Bunder to Thane station. You're right by Masunda Lake, one of the biggest lakes in town.
draft.hungryLine: Thane loves its snacks, so start with a jumbo vada pav near the station and work your way to a plate of misal.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Masunda Lake is a 1 minute walk, and Kopineshwar Mandir, one of Thane's oldest temples, is about 6 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Come back to Masunda Lake at night, go boating, or grab a bite at the food stalls facing the water.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Shivalinga inside Kopineshwar Mandir is considered one of the largest in Maharashtra, and Shiva here is seen as the patron god of Thane.

spots.name: Masunda Lake
spots.detail: 1 min walk · A lake with a Shiv temple on a little island and boating

spots.name: Kopineshwar Mandir
spots.detail: 6 min walk · Thane's patron temple, rebuilt around 1750

spots.name: St. John the Baptist Church
spots.detail: Next to Masunda Lake · A church over 400 years old

legends.title: A lake full of Ganpatis
legends.body: On the last day of Ganeshotsav, thousands of Ganpati idols are brought to Upvan Lake near the Yeoor hills for immersion. The same lake hosts the Sanskruti Arts Festival.

tips.title: Save Masunda Lake for evening.
tips.body: It's one of the best spots in Thane at night, with food stalls and restaurants all along the water.

tips.title: Use Kalwa Naka as a meeting point.
tips.body: It's been a meetup spot for ages and people still meet there today.

story.title: The Bimb palace
story.body: The Marathi text Mahikavatichi Bakhar names Panchpakhadi as the site of the royal palace of the Bimb dynasty. The name means five small villages.

story.title: Chimaji Appa rebuilds
story.body: Chimaji Appa reconstructed Shri Kopineshwar Mandir, one of the oldest temples in Thane.

story.title: India's first train
story.body: The first railway line laid in India ran from Bori Bunder to Thane station, and it's still the city's biggest claim to fame.

story.title: Thana becomes Thane
story.body: The city was known as Thana until 1996. Today it's part of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and one of India's most populous cities, with 1,890,000 people in the 2011 census.

food.name: Kunjvihar
food.detail: Near Thane railway station · Famous for jumbo vada pav, spicy or very spicy

food.name: Mamledar Misal
food.detail: Opposite the Zilla Parishad Office · Go for the misal

food.name: Goras Upahar Gruh
food.detail: Gokhale Road · Authentic Marathi snacks and sweets
